value.rationale: The original finite-horizon positivity-preserving heat splitter raises the nontrivial fixed-grid long-time stability question. The precise 2-to-3 intensity window shows steps can create mean-square instability despite positivity, a.s. decay, and mean-square stability of the spatial semidiscretization. Exact global threshold, strict step dependence, and closed counterexample are valuable structural guidance, without claiming larger-grid generality.
